canonical_name: Open Page: A Meditative Writing Circle
summary: A biweekly meditative free-writing session hosted at Quietude, a retreat/event venue in Black Mountain, NC, teaching continuous stream-of-consciousness writing as a healing practice. Listings are organized by "Quietude" itself (the venue), are ticketed ($5-$20 sliding scale), and are pitched as beginner-friendly and open to "creatives" and anyone with writer's block, with no language distinguishing returning participants from newcomers.

evidence.note: Organizer is listed as "Quietude" (the venue itself), not an independent facilitator or named group, and each of the 5 listings uses near-identical marketing copy describing the technique rather than any community or membership.

Copy is pitched at newcomers ("beginner friendly," "all levels welcome," for anyone "working through writer's block"), with no mention of members, regulars, dues, sign-up forms, or a group name distinct from the event title.
Listings carry a $5-$20 sliding-scale price, consistent with a paid class/workshop format rather than a free or dues-based community group.

Quietude's own site describes hosting general "workshops, classes, and retreats" and "community conversations and learning circles" but does not mention an Open Page writing circle, a facilitator, or a returning group by name.

Web searches for "Open Page" meditative writing circle plus Quietude/Black Mountain/Asheville turned up no dedicated website, Facebook group, Meetup page, or news coverage for this specific circle - only Quietude's general venue pages and unrelated writing groups.
